corrected_fields.summary: Southern California Edison Company (SCE) and parent Edison International filed a Form 8-K on April 28, 2026, disclosing under Regulation FD that management will use a business update presentation (Exhibit 99.1) in meetings with institutional investors and at investor conferences. The filing does not contain the actual presentation content; it only references the exhibit and provides standard forward-looking statement disclaimers.
corrected_fields.why_it_matters: This filing is a routine regulatory disclosure indicating upcoming investor communications by a California utility company. It has no direct relevance to market structure or macro catalysts. The actual investor presentation content referenced in the exhibit is not included in this 8-K filing, making the document thin in terms of actionable information.
